Collegium Musicum Iuvenale Ochsenfurt

Retrospective: Benefit Concert for the 200th Birthday of Johann Strauss

October 26, 2025 · Hotel Meintz Ochsenfurt

Exactly one day after the birthday of the Waltz King on October 25, 1825, the Veeh harp group "Querbeet" led by Sigrid Schäfer gave an international benefit concert on Sunday, October 26, 2025, in the festival hall of the "Meintz" hotel in Ochsenfurt. Together with soloists from Collegium Musicum Iuvenale Ochsenfurt (led by Dr. Astrid Eitschberger) and guests from Italy (Chiara Passudetti, soprano, Silvano Ruffo, tenor, as well as Mirko Ballico on piano and Andrea Vinco on guitar), they presented a lively program with music by Johann Strauss and his contemporaries. Admission was free, and generous donations of €1,183 were handed over to Joachim Gold, the city representative of Malteser in Würzburg, to finance missions of the Malteser Wish Ambulance. During the break and after the concert, guests had the opportunity to view and learn about this special ambulance from the inside.
